identificationModule.briefTitle: Ipatasertib Plus Abiraterone Plus Prednisone/Prednisolone, Relative to Placebo Plus Abiraterone Plus Prednisone/Prednisolone in Adult Male Patients With Metastatic Castrate-Resistant Prostate Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase III, Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled, Multicenter Trial Testing Ipatasertib Plus Abiraterone Plus Prednisone/Prednisolone, Relative to Placebo Plus Abiraterone Plus Prednisone/Prednisolone in Adult Male Patients With Asymptomatic or Mildly Symptomatic, Previously Untreated, Metastatic Castrate-Resistant Prostate Cancer

armGroups.label: Placebo + Abiraterone
armGroups.description: Participants received Placebo plus Abiraterone (along with Prednisone/Prednisolone), administered orally in 28-day cycles.

armGroups.label: Ipatasertib + Abiraterone
armGroups.description: Participants received Ipatasertib plus Abiraterone (along with Prednisone/Prednisolone), administered orally in 28-day cycles.

interventions.name: Ipatasertib
interventions.description: Oral tablets, 400 mg, given once daily (QD) beginning on Day 1 of Cycle 1 until disease progression or intolerable toxicity.

interventions.name: Abiraterone
interventions.description: Oral tablets of abiraterone, 1000 mg QD, taken on an empty stomach and swallowed whole with water.

interventions.name: Placebo
interventions.description: Oral tablets (matched to ipatasertib appearance), given QD beginning on Day 1 of Cycle 1 until disease progression or intolerable toxicity.

interventions.name: Prednisone/Prednisolone
interventions.description: Oral tablets of 5 mg, taken twice daily (BID) until disease progression or intolerable toxicity.
